CARD.label: Section card
CARD.description: Purchase made with the section's card.

REIMBURSEMENT.label: Out of pocket
REIMBURSEMENT.description: You paid for it yourself and get the money back.

MILEAGE.label: Mileage
MILEAGE.description: You drove your own car on the section's errand.

openDatePicker: Pick a date from a calendar

capability.BOOKKEEPING_hint: See every expense and book its voucher. Send back one that was approved by mistake.
capability.ATTEST_VIEW_hint: See the approvals queue. What can actually be attested is decided per expense.
capability.STOCK_VIEW_hint: Read the stock overview and the log.
capability.STOCK_MANAGE_hint: Book stock movements and run an occasion, from takeout to stocktake.
capability.BUDGET_LOCK_hint: Lock an adopted budget, and unlock it.
capability.BUDGET_CHANGE_LOCKED_hint: Record departures and transfers on a locked budget.
capability.FORTNOX_LOGIN_hint: Book in Fortnox under their own login.
capability.EXPORT_UNDO_hint: Mark an exported expense as no longer exported.
capability.CONTRACT_VIEW_hint: See the contract archive and open the documents in it.
capability.EXPENSE_DEADLINE_WAIVE_hint: Grant one late out-of-pocket expense a waiver, so it may be filed after all. Given before the expense goes for approval, with a reason that goes on the expense report.
capability.CONTRACT_MANAGE_hint: Archive contracts, draw rental contracts and keep the rental item catalogue.
capability.FIRMATECKNARE_hint: May be named as the section's signatory on a contract. Opens nothing, and is decided by the stadgar rather than here.
capability.RENTAL_VIEW_hint: See rental contracts in the archive, and nothing else in it. The narrow half of reading contracts.
capability.RENTAL_MANAGE_hint: Draw rental contracts and keep the rental item catalogue.
capability.SEND_REMINDERS_hint: Remind whoever an expense is waiting on, its approvers or the person who submitted it, by email. From the expense, or several at once from the list.
capability.REVIEW_OWN_BOOKING_hint: Post an expense you booked yourself. Otherwise someone else has to review and post it.
capability.BOOKKEEPING_VIEW_hint: See everything Bookkeeping sees: every expense, the section's card purchases and booked income. Without being able to change anything.
capability.AUDIT_REVIEW_hint: Review the financial year's vouchers as an auditor: pass them, ask questions and make remarks.
capability.INVOICE_TRIAGE_hint: See the supplier invoice inbox, add an invoice by hand, give it to a result unit, or delete it. Does not grant approval.
